pnpm.comment-overrides: Patched floors for transitive advisories, all BOUNDED within-major. First block: dev-only toolchains (the @wdio/cli Android-E2E tree). Second block (2026-07-10 prod-audit remediation): PROD-graph transitives — ws (@nestjs/platform-ws + @supabase/realtime-js, memory-exhaustion DoS), multer 2.x (@nestjs/platform-express upload path, nested-field DoS), undici 7.x (cheerio/jsdom scraping, TLS-bypass + WS DoS), plus moderate cleanups (dompurify, postcss, qs, uuid, ip-address, brace-expansion, js-yaml, @opentelemetry/core). Third block (2026-08-05 hygiene sweep): advisory floors from `pnpm audit --fix`, HAND-BOUNDED — audit --fix emits unbounded '>=' floors and pnpm resolves an override range to the HIGHEST matching version, so an unbounded floor silently jumps majors (observed: sanitize-html→2.17.6 pulled ESM-only htmlparser2@12 and broke every CJS require; js-yaml 3.x consumers were forced onto 4.x which deleted safeLoad; express-4's body-parser 1.x was forced to 2.x). NEVER add an unbounded '>=' target here. sanitize-html is pinned EXACTLY 2.17.5: it is the advisory-fixed version whose htmlparser2 (^10, dual CJS/ESM) still loads under Node-20 require + Jest; 2.17.6 requires htmlparser2@12 (ESM-only). The js-yaml <3.15.0 advisory has NO fixed 3.x release (3.14.1 is the last 3.x) — left unpatched in the dev tree rather than force a breaking 3→4 jump.
